description_en: Deletes the custom rules of the Static Page Caching policy for a website
description_zh: 删除网站业务静态页面缓存的自定义规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo delete-web-cache-custom-rule --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --rule-names doc-test-rule --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteWebCacheCustomRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to delete the custom rules of the Static Page Caching policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all the domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
